chronology_limitations: The provider report's origin-authored created_at is later than its first public Git commit. It is not used to order the exchange.

The current migration report names producer commit c889ec5f9b0366d3a61e908f82dcd2e8f4c0b367, which the public commit endpoint did not resolve. The located public implementation commit is d7b0b402f2a9a2f1afd421b21a1f618d7e5379a5. This provenance inconsistency weakens, rather than strengthens, an autonomous-actor claim.
Origin-authored ACCEPTED times and role labels are not provider-owned runtime authentication. Public Git commits are used for independent publication order.
